culsma.tip.stock_exhausted.title: No available tips remain
culsma.tip.stock_exhausted.check: Check the available positions in the indicated tip rack.

culsma.tip.not_attached.title: No tip is attached
culsma.tip.not_attached.check: Check the tip attachment and the preceding pickup operation.

culsma.tip.already_attached.title: A tip is already attached
culsma.tip.already_attached.check: Check the pipette tip state and the requested pickup operation.

culsma.tip.pickup_failed.title: Tip pickup failed
culsma.tip.pickup_failed.check: Check whether the indicated tip is present and seated correctly. This error does not establish that the rack is empty.

culsma.tip.drop_failed.title: Tip release failed
culsma.tip.drop_failed.check: Check the attached tip and the indicated waste or return position.

culsma.liquid.insufficient.title: The liquid supply needs attention
culsma.liquid.insufficient.check: Compare the source amount with the requested aspiration volume.

culsma.liquid.not_detected.title: Liquid was not detected
culsma.liquid.not_detected.check: Check the indicated container, liquid level and detection settings. A missing signal does not prove the container is empty.

culsma.device.not_ready.title: The device is not ready
culsma.device.not_ready.check: Check the indicated module and its operation preconditions.

culsma.device.not_initialized.title: The device is not initialized
culsma.device.not_initialized.check: Check initialization status in the device controls.

culsma.device.busy.title: The device is busy
culsma.device.busy.check: Check the operation already using the device; do not start another operation until its outcome is known.

culsma.module.latch_fault.title: The module lock needs attention
culsma.module.latch_fault.check: Check the indicated plate lock and plate seating using the device controls.

culsma.connection.failed.title: The device connection failed
culsma.connection.failed.check: Check the connection and original operation record. A connection failure does not establish whether an action occurred.

culsma.connection.response_missing.title: The device response is missing
culsma.connection.response_missing.check: Check the connection and original operation record before deciding whether any action may be repeated.

culsma.parameter.out_of_range.title: An operation setting is outside its supported range
culsma.parameter.out_of_range.check: Check the requested setting against the device limits.

culsma.transfer.capacity_exceeded.title: The requested volume exceeds transfer capacity
culsma.transfer.capacity_exceeded.check: Check the requested aspiration, current tip contents and pipette or tip capacity.

culsma.location.invalid.title: The requested position is invalid
culsma.location.invalid.check: Check the indicated labware position and its layout binding.

culsma.location.occupied.title: The destination position is occupied
culsma.location.occupied.check: Check the destination position and the labware already assigned there.

culsma.motion.object_not_found.title: The expected labware was not found
culsma.motion.object_not_found.check: Check the indicated pickup position and labware seating.

culsma.motion.unreachable.title: The requested position cannot be reached
culsma.motion.unreachable.check: Check the position and configured transport path.

culsma.temperature.timeout.title: The target temperature was not reached in time
culsma.temperature.timeout.check: Check the module status and requested temperature in the device controls.

culsma.temperature.sensor_fault.title: The temperature sensor reported a fault
culsma.temperature.sensor_fault.check: Review the module diagnostic and contact the device specialist if required.

culsma.device.method_not_registered.title: The prepared method is not available on this Agent
culsma.device.method_not_registered.check: Ask the device specialist to commission the exact prepared method on the Agent. The method was not dispatched; changing a protocol may require new commissioning.
